name: Band Shrug
description: Standing on the middle of a resistance band with an end in each hand at your sides, lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears against the band, pause, then lower them slowly.

source.title: Trainwell: Band Shrug
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand on the middle of the band, feet hip-width apart.
Hold an end in each hand, arms straight at your sides, palms in.

prescription.note: Arms stay straight; the shoulders move straight up and down, not rolled. Keep the band tight at the bottom.

keyframes.name: Stand on the band
keyframes.cue: Stand on the middle of the band, an end in each hand at your sides.

keyframes.name: Shrug
keyframes.cue: Lift both shoulders straight up toward your ears.
